entries.name: Sales presentation
entries.definition: Presenting a product or service to prospective customers to persuade them to buy.

entries.name: Salesforce
entries.definition: A cloud customer relationship management platform from Salesforce, with applications for sales, service and marketing and tools for building custom apps.

entries.name: Salesforce Datorama
entries.definition: A marketing analytics platform, bought by Salesforce in 2018, that brings together data from many channels for reporting.

entries.name: Salesforce Social Studio
entries.definition: A Salesforce Marketing Cloud tool for publishing, monitoring and analysing social media activity.

entries.name: SAP
entries.definition: The enterprise software from SAP, especially its ERP systems, used to run finance, logistics, manufacturing and human resources processes.

entries.name: SAP BusinessObjects
entries.definition: SAP's business intelligence software suite, originally from BusinessObjects, for reporting, analysis and dashboards.

entries.name: SAP Crystal Reports
entries.definition: A report-design tool, owned by SAP, for creating formatted reports from databases and other data sources.

entries.name: SAP Fiori
entries.definition: SAP's design system and user-interface technology that gives its software a consistent, role-based interface on browsers and mobile devices.

entries.name: SAP GUI
entries.definition: SAP's desktop client program for logging in to and working with SAP systems.

entries.name: SAP IoT
entries.definition: SAP's cloud services for connecting devices and machines, collecting their data and using it in business processes.

entries.name: SAP IS-Retail
entries.definition: SAP's industry solution for retailers, which adds merchandise, assortment and store functions to SAP ERP.

entries.name: SAP Lumira
entries.definition: A self-service tool from SAP for exploring data and building charts and dashboards.

entries.name: SAP Materials Management
entries.definition: The SAP ERP module that handles procurement, inventory and invoice checking for materials.

entries.name: SAP NetWeaver Process Integration
entries.definition: SAP middleware for connecting SAP and non-SAP systems and passing messages between them.

entries.name: SAP Quality Management
entries.definition: The SAP ERP module for planning and recording quality inspections, quality notifications and certificates for materials and production.

entries.name: SAP S/4HANA
entries.definition: SAP's enterprise resource planning suite built to run on the SAP HANA in-memory database.

entries.name: SAP Sovereign Cloud
entries.definition: SAP's cloud offering designed to keep customer data and operations under the legal and operational control of a particular country or region.

entries.name: SAP technology consulting
entries.definition: Advising organisations on the technical side of SAP systems, such as installation, integration, performance and cloud platforms.

entries.name: Savon
entries.definition: A Ruby library for calling SOAP web services.

entries.name: Scaffold building
entries.definition: Erecting and taking down the temporary frameworks of tubes, boards and fittings that give workers safe access to high structures.

entries.name: Scala.js
entries.definition: A compiler that turns Scala code into JavaScript so that Scala programs can run in browsers and on Node.js.

entries.name: Scalding
entries.definition: A Scala library, originally from Twitter, for writing Hadoop MapReduce data-processing jobs concisely.

entries.name: SCARA robot
entries.definition: A type of industrial robot arm, short for Selective Compliance Assembly Robot Arm, that moves in a horizontal plane and is rigid vertically, used for assembly and pick-and-place work.

entries.name: Schema markup
entries.definition: Code added to a web page, using the schema.org vocabulary, that tells search engines what the page's content means.

entries.name: Schematic diagrams
entries.definition: Reading and drawing diagrams that show the parts of a circuit or system and how they connect, using standard symbols.

entries.name: Scholarship of teaching and learning
entries.definition: The systematic study of teaching and student learning, with the findings made public so that others can build on them.

entries.name: School counseling
entries.definition: Helping students with their academic, personal, social and career development as a counsellor in a school.

entries.name: Schoology
entries.definition: A learning management system, now owned by PowerSchool, that schools use for assignments, grading and communication among teachers, students and parents.

entries.name: Scientific computing
entries.definition: Using computational methods and software to simulate, analyse and solve problems in science and engineering.

entries.name: Scientific modelling
entries.definition: Building simplified mathematical or computational representations of natural systems to explain or predict their behaviour.

entries.name: scikit-learn
entries.definition: An open-source Python library of machine-learning algorithms for classification, regression, clustering and data preparation.

entries.name: Scope statement
entries.definition: Writing the document that sets out a project's objectives, deliverables, boundaries and exclusions.

entries.name: Screen design
entries.definition: Designing the layout, content and visual appearance of individual screens in an app, website or device interface.

entries.name: Screen reader
entries.definition: Assistive software that reads on-screen text and interface elements aloud, or sends them to a braille display, for blind and low-vision users.

entries.name: Screening resumes
entries.definition: Reviewing resumes to pick the candidates who match a job's requirements.

entries.name: Screw conveyor
entries.definition: A conveyor that moves bulk material along a trough or tube with a rotating helical screw.

entries.name: Script writing
entries.definition: Writing the dialogue, action and structure of a script for film, television, theatre, radio or video.

entries.name: SD card
entries.definition: A small removable flash-memory card in the Secure Digital format, used to store data in cameras, phones and other devices.

entries.name: Seamanship
entries.definition: The skill of handling, navigating and maintaining a boat or ship safely at sea.

entries.name: Seating guests
entries.definition: Showing arriving guests to their tables or seats in a restaurant, event or venue.
